sources.citation: Lan Mingsheng 蓝明生. 2025. 壮语语音研究的回眸与进展(2013-2024) [Review and progress of Zhuang phonetic research 2013-2024]. 广西民族报 Guangxi Minzu Bao, 25 June 2025, p.7.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: General (all Zhuang), second-hand: states that research on Zhuang '连读变调规则、语调模式、重音、节奏等超音段特征' is '极其匮乏' (extremely scarce) and calls for future study of '重音系统和节奏特性'. Lists Wenshan-area phonology sketches (王碧玉 2013 西畴摩所壮语音系; 李静 文马壮语(文山市区)音系; 赵先进 2021 丘北浪砚壮语音系分析; 杨桂丽 丘北壮语的弱化音节 [Qiubei = Northern/Yei Zhuang]) -- none on Nong stress.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.citation: Jiang Ziyang 江子扬 (Eric C. Johnson). 2015. 中国文山壮语侬话与越南北部侬语语音系统比较研究简介 / A Brief Comparison of the Phonological Systems of Nong Zhuang of Wenshan, China, and Nung of Northern Vietnam. Conference paper, Xichou County, 21 March 2015. 12 pp. (SIL archives 62478)

sources.citation: Johnson, Eric C. 2011. A Lexical and Phonological Comparison of the Central Taic Languages of Wenshan Prefecture, China: Getting More Out of Language Survey Wordlists Than Just Lexical Similarity Percentages. SIL Electronic Working Papers 2011-005. 171 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 3.2.1-3.2.2 Nong Zhuang tone systems (6 tonemes on unchecked syllables, checked-syllable tones by vowel length), 3.4-3.5 consonant/vowel reflexes vs Proto-Tai, 3.7 Nong phonemic inventory with syllable template C (SV) V (V) (C) (pp.115-117). p.110 explicitly says a full phonology would also need 'allophony (including tone sandhi), morphophonology, intonation, etc.' -- i.e. suprasegmentals beyond lexical tone are out of scope. a full-text search for stress/accent/promin/iamb/sesqui = no relevant hits.
